artworks.title: Villa Outside the Porta Pia
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a tall, rustic building on the left. Mountains and towers are visible in the distance. The sky is cloudy with horizontal lines. The artwork features intricate etching with detailed textures. The color palette is monochrome with earthy tones. Two figures are walking on a path towards the building. Trees and bushes are scattered around the scene.

artworks.title: Abraham and the Three Angels
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with an elevated viewpoint displaying a broad landscape. The horizon is positioned high, obscured by trees, revealing ascending hills in the distance. A group of figures, some with wings, are on a path leading from a stately building surrounded by foliage. A rural path curves through the scene, with distant figures near ruins to the left. The engraving features fine, intricate lines detailing the architecture and foliage. The monochromatic palette emphasizes light and shadow, creating depth and texture. There is a tree-bordered structure on the right and partially ruined buildings on the left, contrasting with the open sky where birds are depicted in flight.

artworks.title: Hagar and the Angel
artworks.description: The image is a landscape scene depicting a lush, wooded area. The horizon is low, with detailed trees and vegetation extending upwards. The foliage and figures are depicted using fine lines, stippling, and cross-hatching techniques in monochrome. Two figures stand by water surrounded by dense vegetation, with rolling hills and a cloudy sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Tobias Frightened by the Fish
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon line and rolling hills in the distance. Trees and foliage are scattered on the left, under a cloudy sky with birds. Detailed line work is used for texture in the trees and grass. The black and white color palette highlights the intricate details. In the foreground, a pathway with two figures and a dog leads to a water body where a large fish jumps out.

artworks.title: Elijah in the Wilderness
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a detailed depiction of nature and a narrative scene. An angelic figure gestures to an older man seated near a rocky outcrop. The terrain is filled with foliage, large trees, and a river scene in the background. The horizon is marked by distant trees and open terrain under a cloudy sky. The brushstroke technique resembles etching, providing depth and contrast. A monochromatic color palette is used to create the image, emphasizing texture and form. Deer can be seen grazing on the horizon.

artworks.title: Pan and Syrinx
artworks.description: The image shows a densely wooded landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is obscured by trees and foliage, with a small area to the right showing clouds and sky. The landscape is detailed with fine lines depicting leaves, tree trunks, and undergrowth. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. In the foreground, trees and plants dominate, while a small figure is partially obscured in the distance within the dense vegetation.

artworks.title: Salmacis and Hermaphroditus
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene depicted with an intricate etching technique. The landscape includes trees, foliage, a river, and grazing animals. The color palette is monochrome, featuring various shades of black, white, and gray.

artworks.title: The Fishermen
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with a high horizon, featuring two towers and trees silhouetted against the sky. There are birds in the sky. Intricate, fine brushstrokes define the foliage and rocky terrain. People stand on the rocky riverbank near a winding stream flowing into the distance. Additional figures are seen near the water. The color palette is monochromatic, with black, gray, and white tones. The scene has dense textures and details depicting trees, rocky terrain, and vegetation.

artworks.title: The Spinner and Four Cows
artworks.description: The image depicts a pastoral landscape viewed from above. The horizon is high in the image, with trees obscuring a small structure. Figures are near the entrance. The etching shows fine lines for textures of foliage and sky, including swirling cloud formations and dense leaf patterns. There are animals on the grass near a stream cascading down rocks forming a waterfall. Hills stretch into the distance with birds flying in a softly etched sky. The color palette is monochrome, focusing on light and shadow contrast.

artworks.title: The Two Horsemen
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a vantage point overlooking an expansive scene. The horizon line is subtle, blending background hills and distant structures. The engraving style includes detailed cross-hatching for textures of trees, rocks, and clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia and grey. A path winds around a rocky incline with figures and horses. Trees create depth, leading to hills and distant structures. The sky has stylized clouds, suggesting a breeze. The composition is balanced, with natural elements harmonizing movement and scenery.

artworks.title: The Small Waterfall
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon near the center dividing foreground details from the background. In the distance, a small building is on a hill among rugged terrain and vegetation. In the foreground, rocks and a waterfall are prominent, with water flowing over the rocks. Trees frame the image on both sides, with detailed etching strokes creating a textural quality. The color palette uses black and white tones to show depth and contrast, capturing a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Cardinal
artworks.description: The image shows a dilapidated stone structure from a slightly elevated point of view. The ruins dominate the scene, with the horizon positioned low in the composition. The engraving features intricate details and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The limited color palette consists of sepia or brown tones, typical of pen and ink drawings. In the foreground, a group of figures is depicted amidst rugged terrain, with one person seated to the right. In the background, there are fields, structures, and soft clouds sketched in the sky. A large tree on the left side frames the composition.

artworks.title: Antique Ruins of an Amphitheatre
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural ruins and lush vegetation. The perspective is slightly elevated, displaying ancient structures with columns and arches meeting the sky. The intricate brushstrokes and etching technique create a detailed and textured appearance. The color palette is predominantly sepia. A path bordered by trees and figures near the ruins is in the foreground, while more ruins and trees fill the background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Ruins and a Woman with a Parasol
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural ruins in the center. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, offering a wide view of the area. The horizon is low with ruins dominating the middle. Further structures are visible, implying historical significance and decay. People and animals are present. Vegetation is scattered across a gradually rising terrain. The foreground has rugged land with vegetation, while the sky has subtle horizontal marks and clouds. The sketch uses fine lines characteristic of etchings and a monochromatic color palette of black and white. The image conveys a mix of natural and man-made elements in a peaceful manner.

artworks.title: Landscape with an Artist Sketching
artworks.description: The image shows detailed ruins surrounded by a landscape. A line of hills or low mountains is on the right, with sparse vegetation fading into the distance. Large, dilapidated stone structures with arches and remnants of grand architecture are on the left. The brushstrokes are finely detailed, utilizing lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia and brown tones. People in motion add scale to the architecture. Small trees and bushes lead toward a distant town on the horizon.

artworks.title: Travelers on Road to Left of a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape in an etching style, featuring detailed line work capturing natural and architectural elements. The scene includes figures and animals in the foreground, a river winding through, trees to the left, a bridge crossing the river, and a castle on a hill in the distance. The sky has clouds and birds. The monochrome palette enhances depth and detail.

artworks.title: Woods Bordered by a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, hills, and a castle silhouette in the distance. The etching technique used features detailed line work depicting trees, rocks, and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, shading creates depth. Two figures walk along a path in the foreground, with others visible in the distance. The sky has horizontal lines, clouds, and birds.

artworks.title: Landscape with Laundresses
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape from an elevated viewpoint, showing the depth of the scene. The horizon is high with distant mountains, a light sky, and detailed cross-hatched strokes creating texture. The color palette is monochrome with black and white defining the foliage, mountains, and clouds. A bridge crosses a stream with figures, leading to a cluster of trees. The trees vary in density and stretch towards a village or structure. Rolling hills and mountains form a backdrop.

artworks.title: The Grotto of the Nymph Egeria
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 18.5 x 27.8 cm (7 5/16 x 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the ruins of an ancient structure with an arched ceiling. In the background, there are distant hills and trees. Groups of people are engaging in various activities, providing a sense of scale. The etching style creates detailed textures and captures the essence of the ruins and landscape. The monochromatic color palette adds a classic quality. Some figures are gesturing towards the ruins, while others are reclining on the ground.

artworks.title: House on a Rock
artworks.description: The etching depicts a landscape scene captured from an elevated vantage point. The horizon is high, showing a distant mountain range to the right under a sky with horizontal streaky clouds. On the left, there is a castle-like structure on a cliff, with figures and animals on a rugged path. The etching showcases finely detailed line work, hatching, and cross-hatching for texture and depth. The monochromatic palette of soft grays and blacks emphasizes contrasts and textures. A boulder and foliage are seen nearby, with rolling hills and figures in the distance.

artworks.title: Mercury Silencing Battus
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene from a slightly elevated view. The horizon is high with a mountain range, sky with clouds, a large tree dominates the left, horses to the left, two figures with an ox on the right, a body of water in the middle, and detailed lines creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of brown and black.

artworks.title: Battus Transformed into Stone
artworks.description: The image shows an expansive landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is low with distant hills and soft clouds in the sky. The detailed engraving style creates texture, especially in the trees and figures. The color palette is monochromatic in various shades of brown. A tree, a cow, and two figures are visible near a riverbank. Lush trees fill the scene with detail, leading the eye into the landscape.

artworks.title: The Little Angels on the Hill
artworks.description: The image shows a low vantage point with a cluster of large trees on the left. The horizon is in the middle, with a small structure visible in the distance among rolling hills. The artwork features detailed linework, shading, and a soft sepia color palette. Two figures are conversing near a rocky path with plants. The background includes wooded areas and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: The Large Tree and the Cascade
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with natural elements such as hills, a small bridge, mountains, a tree, and people engaged in various activities. The scene is rendered in a detailed, textured style resembling etching or engraving, using a monochrome color palette. The composition includes figures on a path, a tree to the right, and a group of trees on the left, creating depth in the image.
